name: 62269 · O Fallon, IL
findings: ZIP 62269 (O Fallon) has 112 nonprofit organizations. 45 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 36 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 62269 (O Fallon) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
33% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 62269 (O Fallon) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 64% of the typical level).
